name: Gobillion
long_description: Gobillion is the Pinduoduo for India, we make e-commerce social by enabling customers to buy together in groups and get great deals!

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Roshan is the Founder/CEO of Gobillion (YC S21) and MyriadAI.

He has 10+ years of founding tech startups, Management Consulting (w/ Deloitte, EY and Accenture), advising startups and VC funds. 

He is the RCEP Global Tech 40u40 awardee, Economic Times Young Leader 2019, WEF Global Shaper, TedX speaker and busines thought leader. He has an IIM MBA grad + CS Engineering grad from NIT.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Kulapradip is the Co-Founder/CTO of Gobillion. He has 8+ years of experience in Full Stack Tech Development and IT Consulting with SAP Labs and other high-growth startups. Has a B.Tech (Computer Science) from NIT Silchar
